extracted.intended_audience: clinical trial authors, trialists, reporting guideline developers, journal editors
extracted.subtask_description: Selecting and using the appropriate CONSORT or SPIRIT extension when reporting or planning randomized trials that deviate from the standard two-group parallel design (by design type, data type, or intervention type), and guidance for developing new extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply SPIRIT/CONSORT extensions for non-standard trials
rubrics_metrics.description: The main SPIRIT and CONSORT Statements are based on the 'standard' two-group parallel design; many variations (design, interventions, data) exist and the main statements have been extended or modified for these areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate SPIRIT or CONSORT extension to improve reporting when your trial departs from the standard two-group parallel design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension development policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are interested in developing a new SPIRIT or CONSORT extension please review our extension policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the extension policy and register interest by completing the provided short registration form before developing a new extension.
